conclusions.text: The 24 declared subjects resolve one-to-one against current geography records and the pinned predecessor inventory; this establishes scope identity only.
Nine ONSDI administrative districts join one-to-one by normalized exact name to the nine Mauritius Island district records; area differences are triage, not legal validation.
Census, park points, MSP map polygons, and official descriptions do not establish complete physical island, reef, or settlement inventories.

St Brandon membership, Agaléga cross-source physical membership, Seychelles Other Islands component crosswalk, exact Litto3D target-island footprints, and current complete settlement coverage remain unresolved.
